prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.41 °C/min (4% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 38.7 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.83 s (within 1% of healthy). Valve switching latency remains tightly within normal healthy tolerances.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.40 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 400 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.8 % (5% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.0 bar (within 1% of healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
